blocks.text: ANTIPOLO—June Mar Fajardo became the 19th player in history to reach the 10,000-point club during the first quarter of the 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup game between San Miguel Beer and NLEX. A turnaround hook over Dave Marcelo with 2:22 left in the opening period gave Fajardo his fifth and sixth points, enough to secure his place in the exclusive club that includes 18 locals and one import. READ: PBA: June Mar Fajardo nears 10,000 points but puts team first Fajardo came into the crucial contest needing just five points to reach the milestone.
